title: Wayne Gretzky Los Angeles Kings NHL 2007-08 SGA Kings Legends Mini Jersey
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Fan Apparel & Souvenirs:Hockey-NHL
descriptionText: The Wayne Gretzky Los Angeles Kings NHL 2007-08 SGA Kings Legends Mini Jersey is a collectible item featuring the iconic player in the Los Angeles Kings colors. Officially licensed by the National Hockey League, this mini jersey is perfect for fans of hockey and the legendary Wayne Gretzky. Made for unisex adults, this one-size jersey is a great way to show support for the team and player during the regular season games. Whether for wearing or displaying, this mini jersey is a must-have for any hockey enthusiast.
